sentences.text: The known fossils of Hemiprotosuchus include a skull, jaws, and some postcranial elements.
The genus Hemiprotosuchus was named in 1969 by the paleontologist José Bonaparte.
The type species of the genus is Hemiprotosuchus leali.
Hemiprotosuchus belongs to the family Protosuchidae.
A 2009 cladistic analysis determined that Hemiprotosuchus is the sister taxon of Protosuchus.
Hemiprotosuchus lived during the Late Triassic (Norian stage) in the Los Colorados Formation of northwestern Argentina.
Hemiprotosuchus lived between 227.3 and 205.7 million years ago during the Norian stage.
